#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>

using namespace std;

int count(const vector<int>& cc, int l, int r) {
    bool used[24] = {false};
    int cnt = 0;
    for (int i = l; i <= r; ++i) {
        int c = cc[i];
        if (!used[c]) {
            used[c] = true;
            ++cnt;
        }
    }
    return cnt;
}

int main() {
    int a, b, l, r;
    cin >> a >> b >> l >> r;
    --l; --r;
    int ab = a + b;
    const int m = 4;
    vector<int> cc(ab * m);
    int h = l / ab;
    l -= h * ab;
    r -= h * ab;
    h = (r - l + 1) / ab;
    if (h > 2)
        r -= (h - 2) * ab;
    int d = a > b ? a - b : 1;
    for (int h = 0; h < m; ++h) {
        for (int k = 0; k < a - d; ++k)
            cc[ab * h + k] = k;
        for (int k = 0; k < d; ++k)
            cc[ab * h + a - d + k] = (h % 2 == 0) ? a - d + k : a + k;
    }
    int min_val = a + a;
    for (int k0 = 1; k0 <= d; ++k0) {
        for (int k = 0; k < b; ++k)
            cc[ab * 0 + a + k] = cc[ab * 0 + a - k0];
        for (int k1 = 1; k1 <= d; ++k1) {
            for (int k = 0; k < b; ++k)
                cc[ab * 1 + a + k] = cc[ab * 1 + a - k1];
            for (int k2 = 1; k2 <= d; ++k2) {
                for (int k = 0; k < b; ++k)
                    cc[ab * 2 + a + k] = cc[ab * 2 + a - k2];
                for (int k3 = 1; k3 <= d; ++k3) {
                    for (int k = 0; k < b; ++k)
                        cc[ab * 3 + a + k] = cc[ab * 3 + a - k3];
                    min_val = min(min_val, count(cc, l, r));
                }
            }
        }
    }
    cout << min_val << endl;
    return 0;
}
